Legenda original:
As a founding member of Buffalo Tom and a bestselling author, Bill Janovitz has told music’s stories onstage and on the page. Tomorrow afternoon, Bill joins Jeff and Barry Ament at City WInery in Boston to moderate a conversation about Since Forever, exploring the photographs and memories behind Jeff’s visual memoir.
